description: First-ever EXECUTION (not just compile) of JU0300 (src/legacy/qrpgsrc/ju0300.rpg, unmodified - Part 5 never called it, only compiled it: part05-legacy-probe/part05-txmigr-to2b). Also (re)compiles and calls the 05-13-fixed JU0900C->ZA0500 chain (solutions/05-13/ju0900c-ticket1.clp + solutions/05-13/za0500-ticket3.rpg, the SAME pair part05-13-tickets already got CONFIRMED SUCCESS on, docs/probes.md) - this is the 'after 05-13' state work/design/part08-design-v1.md section 0.1/2 requires as the golden-master baseline for 08-05 (F0805A, JU0300's control-level rewrite) and 08-05b (F0805B/Q0805B, ZA0500's M1/MR rewrite). Neither modernized program exists yet - writing them is blocked on having this real baseline output to diff against (advisor guidance, this session). RUNMODE stays '*TEST' for the JU0900C/ZA0500 call (same choice part05-ju0900c-baseline and part05-13-tickets made) so ZAIKOM is never mutated - no TXRESET needed AFTER this connection, though RUNTXRESET still runs FIRST (same defensive reasoning part05-13-tickets gave: a sibling manifest, part05-mch1202-corrupt, deliberately leaves a stray JUNO='C05119' row in JUCHUD/JUCHUM on purpose, and this connection's own golden-master output must reflect the TRUE db/data/load_v1.sql seed state, not whatever any prior probe happened to leave behind). JU0300 takes no CALL parameters (unlike JU0900C) but reads an optional FTOK customer-code filter from *LDA bytes 11-16 (its own header comment) - CLRFTOK blanks that range first so this run prints EVERY JUCHUL1 record unfiltered, matching what a bare 'CALL JU0300' with a freshly-started job's all-blank *LDA would show. Both programs' printed QSYSPRT output is read directly from this connection's own 'run' section text, NOT via CPYSPLF/collect - part06-0103-freeform's confirmed finding (a qsh system("CALL ...")-invoked job's printer-file output flows directly into that same system() call's own stdout, never becoming a real spooled file) already established this, and part05-ju0900c-baseline/part05-13-tickets both already relied on it successfully for ZA0500's own printed lines. The captured raw text from this connection (work/verify/results/, gitignored) will be hand-copied into a git-tracked expected/ file in this directory as a follow-up commit once this connection's results are read, for F0805A/F0805B/Q0805B's future SQL EXCEPT-free comparison (TXSNAP is V3-only per part05-ju0900c-baseline's own finding - CPYSPLF's TOFILE requires a real spooled file, which this harness's non-interactive jobs never produce). CPJU03/CPZA05/CPJU09 each DLTPGM first (MONMSG CPF0000) before REPLACE(*YES), same reasoning part05-13-tickets gives: a compile failure then leaves the object MISSING rather than silently falling back to a stale object from an earlier, unrelated connection in this same dev-role &LIB. JU0300's own CALL is placed before the JU0900C/ZA0500 chain (simpler, no prior real-hardware execution at all vs. the chain's own already-CONFIRMED SUCCESS precedent) - README.md's hang-risk-last rule is honored by keeping the LESS-precedented step (JU0300) earlier and the MORE-precedented one (the chain) last, on the reasoning that JU0300's own risk profile (no parameters, no *PSSR, straightforward RPG cycle) is lower, not higher, than the chain's - if this ordering assumption is wrong, a future connection's own read of the results must correct it. Prerequisite: TXSETUP has already built the sample DB (JUCHUM/JUCHUL1/JUCHUD/ZAIKOM) in &LIB, same prerequisite every part05-legacy-* manifest already assumes.

steps.label: CPJU03
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(JU0300) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPZA05
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(ZA0500) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPJU09
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(JU0900C) REPLACE(*YES)
